channel.ns1:author: Samuel Ramsden
channel.ns1:summary: So glad you have found us! Welcome to Silly Stories for Kids — a podcast of wild adventures, made up on the spot and recorded so you and your family can join in the fun that goes on inside Sam’s brain. You could even be in a Silly Story by registering your family over on our website www.sillystoriesforkids.com We love kids and we love family. Our hope is that this podcast will be used in so many creative and amazing ways to bring joy to kids, expand imaginations and bring families together through laughter and crazy fun. Whether you choose to listen together at home, add some fun to your car trips, or take a moment to yourself while your kids listen, you can relax knowing they are enjoying some safe (but still crazy) screen-free fun. So, do you know what’s going to happen in today’s story? Neither do we! There’s only one way to find out… Okay, let’s go! Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

We love kids and we love family. Our hope is that this podcast will be used in so many creative and amazing ways to bring joy to kids, expand imaginations and bring families together through laughter and crazy fun.


Whether you choose to listen together at home, add some fun to your car trips, or take a moment to yourself while your kids listen, you can relax knowing they are enjoying some safe (but still crazy) screen-free fun.


So, do you know what’s going to happen in today’s story? Neither do we!

There’s only one way to find out…


Okay, let’s go!

item.title: 🪑 Thats Not My Chair! 🪑
item.description:
🎉🏆 This isn’t just any Silly Stories for Kids episode… it’s a very special one celebrating the winners of our 1st Kids Picture Book Competition! 📚✨ Join Ollie and the cheeky Pim Pim as they discover a mysterious wibbly wobbly chair, tumble through a secret tunnel, and visit the wonderfully wobbly land where nothing stands still! 😂🪑🌈🌀🤪💜
Head to sillystoriesforkids.com for more fun!

item.title: 🎭💜✨ The Pim-Pim-pectacular ✨💜🎭
item.description:
Pim Pim has decided to put on the greatest show EVER… all by himself! 😲🎟️😂 But there’s one tiny problem—he hasn’t actually planned a show! 🤦‍♂️🎪 Luckily, Teddy Winkle, Tiger Pow and Bomfree are ready to help, bringing cartwheels 🤸, superhero flying 🐯🦸, flower hands 🌸 and some VERY mixed-up magic! 🪄🐘🤣 Can Pim Pim learn that everything is better with friends?
Plus, Adelaide—we’re coming! 🎉 Get ready for the Silly Stories Spectacular on 21 November! 🎭
OK… Let’s Go!
👉 ⁠ www.sillystoriesforkids.com/tickets

item.title: 🎲🐍 Snakes and Ladders, Wheels and Chairs 🪜🦽
item.description:
🎲🐍 Sophie, Hayden and Jackson are playing Snakes and Ladders when a fuzzy purple visitor appears! 💜😂 Pim Pim has LOTS of questions… and soon Sophie’s wheelchair gets a seriously silly upgrade! 🦽⚙️✨ With help from Bonigo and Teddy Winkle, it’s transformed into a flying, music-playing, party-making machine! 🚀🎉🍿 But what happens when they press the WHOLE NEIGHBOURHOOD PARTY button?! 🕺🌧️

item.title: 🐶🐱🐰 Pim Pim Gets a Pet 🐠🐭🦆
item.description:
Jack, Audrey and Darcy are finishing the supermarket shopping when Pim Pim races past on a mission: he needs a PET! 🛒💜 And he’s decided he’ll take one of everything! 🐶🐱🐰
Soon there’s a very slobbery dog greeting, an aquarium on Pim Pim’s head and a shopping pile fit for several different animals! 🐠😂 But choosing a pet gets even sillier when Pim Pim puts on the collar himself and becomes “Puppy Pim Pim”! 🐾 The kids lead their barking purple friend to the animal shelter… can they help him find the right companion before he adopts the whole place? 🏡✨ OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: ✂️🧋Get a Job🧋✂️
item.description:
Ardie and Miles are unwrapping their brand-new remote control car when Pim Pim pops his fuzzy purple head through the window… and decides he wants one too! 🚗💜 There’s just one problem: he needs money, and he has absolutely NO idea how a job works! 😂
Soon, the boys are helping him hunt for work, with bubble tea that makes customers burp REAL bubbles 🧋🫧 and a hairdressing attempt involving some very questionable stripes! ✂️😳 Pim Pim reckons he’s the best at everything, but can they find a job that actually suits his spectacular silliness? 🤸🤣 OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: 🍫 Wheres My Chocolate Bar? 🍫
item.description:
Keanu’s quiet morning with a book is interrupted by a teddy bear at the window… demanding to know who took his chocolate bar! 📚🧸🍫 Teddy Winkle needs answers, and Keanu is ready to help crack the case. 🔍 But these detectives won’t be walking anywhere. Their shimmering slap bands can whisk them straight to the next clue! ✨
A tuft of purple fluff leads to Pim Pim, whose idea of telling the time is VERY unusual. 💜⏰ Then there’s a mysterious mention of cupcakes… and a visit to Thingy Whopper sends flour flying! 🧁💨 Can Keanu untangle the muddle before Teddy Winkle accuses EVERYONE? 😂 OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: 🪭 The Fan 🪭
item.description:
Holly, Aubree, Brinley and Zahli are WAY too hot to sleep! 🥵🛏️ Luckily, Pim Pim bursts out of a toy box with an idea: they need a fan! 💜 But does a giant windmill count? With Teddy Winkle along for the ride, a simple search for a cool breeze is about to get very silly… 🧸💨
There’s a monster truck to drive, gigantic high fives to try, and a supersized Zali putting her friends on the roof! 🛻🖐️🏠 Add a little gigantifier spray and a leaf blower, and what could possibly go wrong? Can the girls cool their bedroom without blowing everyone away? 😂 OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: 🧦 Missing Socks 🧦
item.description:
🧦😲 Where DO all those missing socks go?! Harley and Ali are helping Mum sort the washing when they discover a pile of socks with no matching pairs! But when Pim Pim 💜 and Teddy Winkle 🧸 pop out of the laundry, they promise to reveal the BIG secret behind disappearing socks!
With a giant leap into a washing basket, the kids find themselves in Washing Land! 🧺✨ There are bouncy bedsheet trampolines 🤸, sparkly explosions 🌟 and fluffy towels that act like farm animals! 🐑😂 But when Pim Pim decides to let the towels go FREE RANGE, things get VERY bouncy! Can they round them all up and finally solve the mystery of the missing socks? 🧦🌳
OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: 🏃🏾🧸 The Teddy's Trail 🧸🏃🏼‍♀️
item.description:
Declan and Poppy have JUST finished tidying their toy room when Teddy Winkle bursts in, hunting for a naughty teddy bear! 🧸🔍 But this runaway has a sneaky escape route… their toy box can TELEPORT! 📦✨
Soon the kids are searching a bright pink toy room, chasing a cartwheeling teddy and scrambling through Pim Pim’s enormous toy piles. 💗🤸 Apparently, that mess is in “alphabetical upside down order”! 😂 Throw in a toy car launching through the air, and catching one little bear becomes a VERY bumpy adventure. 🚗💨 Can they keep up—and why is Teddy Winkle so determined to catch him?
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!

item.title: 😕🎶 Pim Pim Goes Nowhere! 🎶😕
item.description:
What do you do when things don’t quite go to plan?
Join us for an extra-special musical as we follow a day in the life of Pim Pim! He’s got some incredible plans, but things turn out a little differently than he expected.
Filled with fun, songs and silliness, come along for the adventure!

item.title: 💜🌸 Pim Pim in Petals 🌸💜
item.description:
Marley, Lola and Poppy are playing at the park when Pim Pim comes cartwheeling over with a VERY special flower! 💜🌸 Apparently, it opens a portal to a secret flower world… if he can work out how to use it! 😂 One sniff later, the kids are off to Flowerland, where the flowers play music and dancing creates fabulous petal outfits! 🎶👗✨
Pim Pim’s dance moves earn him a rather tiny hat, but he’s sure he’ll be brilliant at flying a giant flower petal. What could possibly go wrong?! 🤸🌺 And with a flower party about to begin, can everyone keep the silliness under control? 🎉 OK… Let’s Go!
👉 Head to www.sillystoriesforkids.com for more stories, songs and heaps of fun!
